summary: New nether biomes don t work properly in buffet worlds
description: The bug The new nether biomes (nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest, warped forest and basalt deltas) do not work in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce - Create New World - Select More World Options - Make a buffet world - Select Soul Sand Valley - Set terrain type to Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode Freezes the game before it even loads terrain (Image Below) -Surface mode creates a purely ocean world (This happened the first time i tried to make one but works fine now for some reason) The following list is updated in version 20w15a: Biomes All world generators that freeze the game Nether wastes Surface Crimson forest Surface Warped forest Surface and floating islands Soul sand valley Surface Basalt deltas Surface
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world.
3. Select "More World Options."
4. Choose "Buffet" world type.
5. Select "Soul Sand Valley" as the biome.
6. Set the terrain type to "Floating Islands" or "Surface."
7. Wait for the game to load the terrain.
8. Observe that the game freezes before loading the terrain.
Observed Behavior: The new Nether biomes, including Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, and Basalt Deltas, do not function correctly in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. When attempting to create a new world and selecting a buffet world with the Soul Sand Valley biome while setting the terrain type to Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island, the game freezes before the terrain loads. This issue has been observed consistently, with the game failing to progress beyond the loading screen. In Surface mode, it has been noted that the world generates as a purely oceanic environment, although this behavior seems inconsistent as it worked correctly during a subsequent attempt. In version 20w15a, it was confirmed that all world generators that cause the game to freeze include Nether Wastes and the various biomes when set to Surface. This issue presents a significant barrier to players wishing to explore the new Nether biomes in these specific world types.
Expected Behavior: When creating a buffet world and selecting the new nether biomes (such as Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, Basalt Deltas, and Nether Wastes), the game should successfully generate the selected biome without freezing or crashing. Players should be able to explore these biomes as intended, experiencing their unique features and landscapes, regardless of the terrain type set to Floating Islands or Surface. Each biome should generate properly, maintaining the intended gameplay experience as seen in standard Nether worlds.
